visual.general_description: Six-panel composite: two coronary angiogram images (A, C), a photograph of aspirated material on mesh with a 10 mm scale bar (B), two chest CT images (D, E) with arrows on E, and an echocardiogram still (F).
visual.detailed_description: Top row: A, a grayscale coronary angiogram with a wire and a magnified inset; B, an orange mesh with two small dark fragments and a 10 mm scale bar; C, a second grayscale coronary angiogram. Bottom row: D, an axial chest CT image; E, a magnified CT image with two white arrows; F, a sector ultrasound image with an ECG trace and a small "JPEG" label. Panel letters A to F are printed at upper left of each panel.
